card.name: "Subsequently" opening a dosing sentence
card.fires_on: The ending "sequently" of the word "Subsequently" at the start of a sentence, mainly in dosing or titration instructions that follow an earlier step.

modes.label: Next dosing step
modes.description: "Subsequently" begins a sentence that gives the next change in dose after a first step.
